general.prompt_ru: Расскажи, как прошёл твой день. Что было хорошего, а что — сложного?
general.prompt_en: Tell me about your day. What went well, and what was difficult?
followups: Why was that part difficult?
What would you do differently next time?
How did that make you feel?

general.prompt_en: Describe your plans for the weekend.
followups: Who are you doing that with?
Have you done this before?
What are you most looking forward to?

general.prompt_ru: Если бы у тебя была неделя свободного времени, что бы ты сделал?
general.prompt_en: If you had a free week, what would you do?
followups: Why did you choose that?
Where would you go?
Who would you take with you?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи о городе, в котором ты вырос.
general.prompt_en: Tell me about the city where you grew up.
followups: What do you miss most about it?
How has it changed?
Would you like to live there again?

general.prompt_ru: Какая привычка сильнее всего изменила твою жизнь?
general.prompt_en: What habit has changed your life the most?
followups: How did you start that habit?
What was hard about keeping it?
Would you recommend it to others?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши свой обычный рабочий день от начала до конца.
general.prompt_en: Describe a typical work day of yours, from start to finish.
followups: What part of the day is most productive for you?
What would you change about it?
How do you usually relax after work?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи о фильме или книге, которая произвела на тебя впечатление.
general.prompt_en: Tell me about a movie or book that impressed you.
followups: What was it about?
Why did it stand out to you?
Would you recommend it to a friend?

general.prompt_ru: Какая цель для тебя сейчас самая важная?
general.prompt_en: What goal is most important to you right now?
followups: What steps are you taking toward it?
What's the biggest obstacle?
How will you know you've achieved it?
What time would you wake up?
Who would you spend it with?
What would make it perfect?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи о последнем путешествии, которое тебе понравилось.
general.prompt_en: Tell me about the last trip you enjoyed.
followups: What surprised you the most?
Would you go back?
What would you tell a friend planning to go there?

general.prompt_ru: Как ты обычно принимаешь сложные решения?
general.prompt_en: How do you usually make difficult decisions?
followups: Can you give an example?
Do you ask others for advice?
How do you know you made the right choice?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши человека, который на тебя сильно повлиял.
general.prompt_en: Describe a person who influenced you a lot.
followups: What did you learn from them?
How do you stay in touch now?
What quality of theirs do you admire most?

general.prompt_ru: Какие новости на этой неделе привлекли твоё внимание?
general.prompt_en: What news caught your attention this week?
followups: What's your opinion on it?
How might it affect people?
Did it change how you think about something?

general.prompt_ru: Опиши, как ты обычно проводишь утро.
general.prompt_en: Describe how you usually spend your morning.
followups: What's the first thing you do after waking up?
Do you have a morning routine?
What would an ideal morning look like?

general.prompt_ru: Расскажи о навыке, который ты хочешь развить в этом году.
general.prompt_en: Tell me about a skill you want to develop this year.
followups: Why is it important to you?
How are you practicing it?
What progress have you made so far?

technical.prompt_ru: Опиши на английском, чем ты занимаешься на работе.
technical.prompt_en: Describe, in English, what you do at work.
followups: What's the most challenging part of your job?
What tools or equipment do you use daily?
Who do you usually collaborate with?

technical.prompt_ru: Расскажи о недавней проблеме на производстве и как вы её решили.
technical.prompt_en: Tell me about a recent production problem and how it was solved.
followups: What was the root cause?
How long did it take to fix?
What did you learn from it?

technical.prompt_ru: Объясни коллеге, как работает какой-либо процесс или оборудование, которое ты хорошо знаешь.
technical.prompt_en: Explain to a colleague how a process or piece of equipment you know well works.
followups: What safety steps are involved?
What happens if it fails?
How would you train a new worker on it?

technical.prompt_ru: Опиши, как ты бы объяснил задержку в проекте руководителю.
technical.prompt_en: Describe how you would explain a project delay to your manager.
followups: What caused the delay?
What's your plan to catch up?
How do you prevent this next time?

technical.prompt_ru: Расскажи о том, как проходит инструктаж по технике безопасности на твоём объекте.
technical.prompt_en: Tell me how a safety briefing works at your site.
followups: Who leads the briefing?
What topics are usually covered?
How often do briefings happen?

technical.prompt_ru: Опиши, как ты определяешь приоритеты задач в течение дня.
technical.prompt_en: Describe how you prioritize tasks during your day.
followups: What do you do when priorities conflict?
How do you handle urgent requests?
What tools help you stay organized?

technical.prompt_ru: Расскажи о совещании, в котором ты недавно участвовал.
technical.prompt_en: Tell me about a meeting you recently took part in.
followups: What was decided?
Did you present anything?
What would you improve about how it was run?

technical.prompt_ru: Опиши деталь или узел оборудования и его назначение, будто объясняешь новому сотруднику.
technical.prompt_en: Describe a component or piece of equipment and its purpose, as if explaining it to a new employee.
followups: What could go wrong with it?
How is it maintained?
Why is it important to the whole system?

technical.prompt_ru: Расскажи, как ты бы вёл переговоры с поставщиком о сроках поставки.
technical.prompt_en: Tell me how you would negotiate delivery times with a supplier.
followups: What would you say if they refuse?
What's your backup plan?
How do you build a good relationship with vendors?

technical.prompt_ru: Опиши шаги, которые ты предпринимаешь при диагностике неисправности.
technical.prompt_en: Describe the steps you take when diagnosing a fault.
followups: What tools do you use?
How do you know when it's fixed?
How do you document the fix?
